symptom: package lombok does not exist with Lombok only on -processorpath
correction: Lombok must be on -cp (annotations) and -processorpath (processor)

symptom: delombok writes "Generated by delombok at <time>" comments: output differs per run
correction: drop the stamp lines; output is byte-deterministic

symptom: M3Path::toFile in the loader: Path there is java.nio.file.Path via a star import
correction: rename an unqualified token only if javac scope makes it ours (own package, single-type import, on-demand import of our package)

symptom: import jdk.m3.graphics.sksg.InvalidationController not renamed
correction: a qualifier that starts with a new package (sub-packages) also qualifies a type token

symptom: SWT uses impl.Native/impl.Library; jdk.internal.m3.graphics would be an unqualified jdk.internal export
correction: impl -> jdk.m3.graphics.impl; ledgers and recipe regenerated

symptom: Bash tool collapsed \b to a backspace byte inside a generated regex
correction: write regex-bearing tools with the Write tool; fix_bs pass replaced 5 bytes

symptom: 217 donor files had CRLF
correction: normalize_lf.py before commit

symptom: SWT M3Library.java names Skija impl.Library fully qualified; a naive "M3Library is taken" check flagged it
correction: qualified uses never collide; COLLISION_QUALIFY applies only to unqualified tokens, at the rename site

symptom: io.github.humbleui.skija.* and io.github.humbleui.types.* both became import jdk.m3.graphics.* (M3Target.java); ecj warns
correction: IMPORT_DEDUPE v1 keeps the first identical import line

symptom: .superset/conflicts archives matched humbleui but are records, not live code (not on disk in a sparse worktree)
correction: consumer list = bundles/, tests/, examples/, docs/m3/*/tools/ Java; archives and ledgers excluded and listed

symptom: value types whose constructors take other value types (AnimationFrameInfo, GradientStyle, FontArguments) had no receiver
correction: recipe levels: level k may take values of types buildable before level k; final pass keeps the best acyclic option

symptom: recipes picked JNI-style constructors (AnimationFrameInfo(IIZIZII..), TextBox(FFFFI)): random ordinals and unordered edges failed almost every receiver
correction: score prefers enum-typed parameters (fewest null, most enum, fewest value, fewest arrays, most parameters, constructors first)

symptom: ImageWithFilterResult(Image, IRect, IPoint) with a null Image: Lombok @NonNull rejects it, every receiver threw
correction: a body with "is marked non-null but is null" rejects null parameters; instances then need a native type: members BLOCKED_NATIVES

symptom: test method native() is a Java keyword; CASES constants were shared by atoms with equal counts (verify(CASES_CLEANABLE) in the Native test)
correction: keyword-safe method names (suffix Atom); CASES constants keyed by atom, not by value

symptom: snake case of EncodeJPEGAlphaMode was ENCODE_JPEGALPHA_MODE; constant and descriptor lines over 120 columns
correction: split acronyms before a capitalized word; descriptor constant names capped at 24 characters; long literals cut after ';'

symptom: the oracle jar is Multi-Release; versions/9 variants of Cleanable, ReferenceUtil, ResourceFinder were not in the inventory
correction: MR_VARIANT detection from META-INF/versions/N entries; ATOM_TESTS.tsv oracle_variant column (ATOM_FINDINGS F1-F3)

symptom: hashCode of value objects with an enum field differs between the sides (Enum.hashCode is an identity hash)
correction: M3GraphicsAtomsHashes: compare a hashCode only when no enum or identity-hashed part is in the value; skips counted per atom

symptom: Boolean results went through jdk() -> outcomes() -> jdk(): StackOverflowError; Bidi.toString threw inside the comparator
correction: equals and toString of JDK objects called directly and guarded; a throwing call compares by type

symptom: ResourceFinder.findResource returned a class-path directory URL on the M3 side and a jar URL on the oracle side
correction: a URL compares by presence (environment rule, counted); the code difference is ATOM_FINDINGS F3

symptom: every LinkageError counted as reaching natives: NoClassDefFoundError sun.misc.Cleaner and a NullPointerException inside M3Library.readResource were misreported
correction: natives = UnsatisfiedLinkError, or a frame of a loading method (staticLoad, load, _loadFrom*, _nAfterLoad) of impl.Library in the cause chain

symptom: receivers built by validating constructors mostly threw, so instance members tested only the constructor's checks
correction: buildable(): the first of 8 alternative rounds the oracle builds; constructor cases still use every round

symptom: rows called p.row(atom, kind, name, descriptor, pattern): argument order differed from M3GraphicsAtomsPerfSupport.row
correction: emit p.row(atom, pattern, kind, name, descriptor, loops)

symptom: fixed 200k ops per round: 4 min with microsecond exception paths; zero-call rows timed empty loops
correction: passes doubled until a round takes 2 ms; DIVERGENT and NOT_MEASURED rows are not timed; a URL-returning member is ENVIRONMENT

symptom: loops called the handle through a shared static helper: ratios 0.11..1.5 for identical code (inlining and tiered-compilation variance)
correction: the constant handle is invoked in each generated loop, results go to a CompileCommand blackhole, -XX:-TieredCompilation -Xbatch: p10..p90 0.95..1.03

symptom: Bash tool collapsed \n and \\ inside heredoc Python edits (a split string literal, a Java regex)
correction: backslash-bearing edits via the Edit/Write tools; py_compile / javac after each edit
